limitations: Only the labeled train split is fetched; the leaderboard test split ships without labels.
Adversarial-attack rows are retained and flagged via the attack column; clean evaluation uses attack=none unless stated.
RAID covers English prose domains plus code/Czech/German in extra.csv, which is not fetched here.

source.download_instructions: Run `python -m bench.fetch_raid`. The script downloads the labeled train.csv from Hugging Face, verifies it against the pinned SHA-256 hash, applies documented hygiene filters, and stores a clean parquet under datasets/local/raid/ (gitignored). Raw text is never committed to this repository.
